thread:
incident-bot: Pager: Elevated error rate detected for /v1/generate (5xx ~18%, baseline ~0.4%). First observed at 1842105678. Auto-notified #incidents and eng-sre oncall.

AlexM: I'm looking. Quick check of API gateway: large spike in 429 from quota-service followed by upstream 502/503.

SaraP: nginx logs confirm sequence: client -> quota-service returns 429 -> gateway retries -> upstream returns 502/503.

JuliaOps: Any recent deploys? I see a quota-controller rollout at ~10:12 (PR #4567 merged earlier today) that changed weight calc for batch requests.

MikeSRE: Paging @MikeSRE (oncall) — taking. Starting with deploy & pod health.

AlexM: Quota-service logs (snippet):
```
time="2026-04-22T10:15:01Z" level=warn msg="quota denied" user="acct-987" bucket="global-dyn"
error="rate-limiter: out of tokens"
```
Also seeing Redis calls to 10.0.3.5 at ~200ms.

PriyaProd: CS: we're getting inbound tickets from 3 enterprise customers reporting high latency/errors. Flagging possible customer impact.

SaraP: Repro steps: send 20 concurrent small requests -> first few succeed then quota-service returns 429 consistently, then gateway surfaces 502s as retries pile up.

JuliaOps: Immediate mitigation options: 1) revert PR #4567, 2) scale quota-service, 3) flip off global token bucket, 4) suppress gateway retries on 429.

MikeSRE: I'm going to scale the quota-service and add a temporary circuit-breaker in gateway for 429s. Running: `kubectl -n platform scale deploy/quota-service --replicas=10`

AlexM: I have a small admin toggle to disable the global token bucket (safe fallback). Prepare to apply if scaling doesn't reduce errors.

PriyaProd: Drafting customer-facing note for CS. Need brief impact, what we changed, ETA.

MikeSRE: Scaling in progress — pods coming up. Running health checks. Also opening a quick Redis inspection.

AlexM: Admin toggle applied (command):
```
curl -s -X POST "https://admin.internal/config" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"global_bucket":"off"}'
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```

SaraP: Metrics update after changes: 5xx down from 18% -> 3% within 3m, now trending ~1.2% over last 5m. Still seeing 429s on large batch flows.

JuliaOps: Also pushed gateway tweak: stop retrying on 429 to prevent retry amplification (proxy_next_upstream off for 429). Will monitor for regression in client-visible errors.

MikeSRE: Redis latency trending back to baseline after evicting stale cluster keys (ran quick RC eviction script). Quota-service pods stable at 10/10.

PriyaProd: CS update ready: "We experienced a quota configuration change that caused global bucket saturation, leading to cascading 429s and gateway 5xx for some high-concurrency customers. Mitigations applied: disabled global token bucket, scaled quota-service, and disabled gateway retries for 429s. Impact limited to a subset of customers using large batched requests. Recovery in progress; next update in 30m." Sending now.

AlexM: Root-cause hypothesis: PR #4567 changed per-request weight for batch requests, causing the global bucket to be depleted much faster under high concurrency. That created a feedback loop with retries.

MikeSRE: Taking ownership for the incident while it's being monitored. Handoff plan: I'll keep watch for 30m then hand to @JuliaOps if stable. Recording timeline for postmortem.

JuliaOps: Action items (initial): revert PR #4567, add unit tests for weight calc, add canary gating & feature flag for config changes, add distinct alert for quota saturation (separate from 5xx alerts), document emergency admin toggle flow.

AlexM: I'll open the rollback PR and include a changelog + test.

PriyaProd: Noted CS follow-ups: outreach to impacted accounts, add incident summary and RCA draft once postmortem ready.

incident-bot: Incident state changed: mitigated -> monitoring. Severity adjusted to Sev2. Runbook pinned: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/quota-fanout (link).

MikeSRE: Monitoring window started. Will update in 15m unless changes.

AlexM: Quick thumbs up from me if metrics stay stable. :thumbsup:

SaraP: Logging additional traces for later postmortem.

JuliaOps: Oncall handover note: next shift @JuliaOps at 1842110000 will take if no regressions.

PriyaProd: Thanks team — CS notified customers and queued follow-ups.

MikeSRE: Ending live mitigation chat — keeping channel open for follow-ups and postmortem drafting.
